name: context-foundation
description: Local search over a large codebase and its design docs by meaning and keywords. Adds a read-only MCP search tool for finding where something is implemented or documented (from another engine's term, or a plain-language or Japanese description), a hook that tells the agent to use it before grep only in workspaces with an index, a fallback skill, a setup skill that walks the user through setup and registers an embedding model already on the PC, /context-setup to install the search's Python packages and register the folder of an embedding model already on the PC in a dialog (it never downloads the model), and /context-index to build the index. Retrieval only; the code never leaves the PC.
